description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The value is generated from your client and must be unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The ID of the destination region to which to copy the snapshot.

description.zh:
新快照的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://或https://开头。

默认值：空。
description.en:
The description of the new snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

Default value: null.

description.zh:
新快照的名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https:// 开头。支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。

默认值：空。
description.en:
The name of the new snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain letters, digits, and Unicode characters that are categorized under the letter classification. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

Default value: null.
> This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

- true：是。
- false：否。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

- true: encrypts the cloud disk.
- false: does not encrypt the cloud disk.

Default value: false.

description.zh: 目标地域的KMS用户主密钥。
description.en: The customer master key (CMK) in the destination region.

description.zh: 源快照所在的地域。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the source snapshot. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh:
新快照的保留时长，单位为天，到期后快照会被自动释放。取值范围：1~65536。

默认值：空，表示快照不会被自动释放。
description.en:
The retention period of the new snapshot, in days. The snapshot undergoes automatic release when the retention period expires. Valid values: 1 to 65536.

Default value: null, which indicates that the snapshot does not undergo automatic release.
The ID of the source snapshot.
The tag information of the new snapshot.

description.zh: 新快照的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag key of the new snapshot. Once specified, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

description.zh: 新快照的标签值。一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag value of the new snapshot. Once specified, the tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 复制后的新快照不能回滚源快照对应的云盘。
- 不支持复制本地快照。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, take note of the following items:

- The new snapshot cannot be used to roll back the cloud disk that is associated with the source snapshot.
- Local snapshots cannot be copied.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs copy-snapshot --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --destination-region-id us-east-1 --snapshot-id s-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --destination-snapshot-name CopySnapshotDemo --destination-snapshot-description CopySnapshotDemo --retention-days 60 --encrypted false --kms-key-id 0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fb400000 --arn AssumeRoleFor=0 RoleType=example-string Rolearn=example-string --destination-storage-location-arn example-string --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
